## Summary

Describe the user-visible behavior and the project boundary affected by this change.

## Verification

- [ ] `moon fmt --check`
- [ ] `moon check --target all --deny-warn`
- [ ] `moon test --target all --deny-warn`
- [ ] Relevant CLI or example commands
- [ ] Public interface diff reviewed with `moon info --target all`

## Documentation and Compliance

- [ ] README, API documentation, and CHANGELOG are updated when needed
- [ ] New fixtures are generated or have a documented redistributable license
- [ ] Success paths, boundary cases, and stable error behavior are tested
- [ ] No private, commercial, sensitive, or source-unknown material is included
